name: Darshak Sondagar
title: Senior Software Engineer
headline: Building scalable enterprise web experiences with Angular, React & TypeScript
summary:
Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience designing, developing, modernizing, and optimizing web applications
using Angular, React.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript. Strong expertise in building scalable Single Page Applications (SPAs),
reusable UI components, REST API integrations, responsive web interfaces, and frontend performance optimization. Hands-on
experience with RxJS, NgRx, Redux, Angular Material, Ionic, and enterprise application development across finance
transformation, bank reconciliation, payments, international remittance, prepaid cards, eKYC, expense management, and
talent management solutions. Experienced in end-to-end feature delivery, Agile collaboration, application modernization,
performance improvement, and AI-assisted software development.
valueProposition: I help teams ship polished, high-performance frontends for complex products—from finance and payments to AI gateway experiences—with maintainable architecture and measurable UX impact.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
highlights: Worked on HubGPT UI and gateway/API enhancements, including deep-linking, reasoning behavior, Luminary Card UI with Glean Agent integration, and multi-Slack and embedded agent onboarding flows. Implemented admin agent-view notifications across both frontend and gateway layers, along with platform improvements focused on agent onboarding, integrations, navigation, and overall user experience.

Designed and developed the MCP onboarding flow, translating Figma designs into responsive UI and implementing end-to-end API integrations. Worked on SAFE-related integrations, OpenAPI guidance, validation, and error handling, along with frontend and gateway-side enhancements to streamline MCP configuration, onboarding, and integration workflows.

experience.title: Software Engineer
highlights: Developed and optimized an enterprise Finance Transformation application using Angular, improving frontend UI performance and rendering efficiency by approximately 30%.
Developed Bank Reconciliation workflows and integrated REST APIs to support financial data processing, reconciliation operations, and efficient user workflows.
Built the TalentPool module end-to-end across frontend and backend to onboard employee and SME profiles, track client engagement, and manage assignment, leave, and availability states.
Developed SpendChecks, an Ionic mobile application for Android and iOS, enabling users to add, approve, and reject expenses with real-time status tracking.
Implemented secure data handling, approval workflows, reusable UI components, and API integrations to improve usability and streamline expense-processing operations.
Worked on API integration and database queries to ensure smooth communication between frontend(Angular 15) and backend(Java).

experience.title: Software Engineer
highlights: Developed a scalable and modular Angular Single Page Application (SPA) with responsive UI for International Remittance, Prepaid Card, and eKYC services.
Led development of the Cashup Agent Portal, automating commission calculations and reducing calculation errors by approximately 20%.
Built a web-based NFC payment portal for Shukur, enabling users to complete payment transactions without requiring a dedicated mobile application.
Integrated REST APIs and developed reusable frontend components to support maintainable, scalable, and responsive product development.

experience.title: Associate Front-end Engineer
highlights: Developed secure and interactive web applications with responsive user interfaces and modern frontend development practices.
Contributed to frontend architecture and application development with a focus on scalability, maintainability, and website performance.

highlights: Learned about teamwork, new technologies, and building creative web pages.
